description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/central_D2_dirichlet_bc driven by problems/heat_1d_dirichlet.esm. The problem file is loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4) — no per-resolution fixture files. The manufactured solution exp(-alpha pi^2 t) sin(pi x) + gL + (gR - gL) x is exact for the continuous PDE with constant wall values gL = 0.5, gR = 1.5 (derivation in the problem file); the steady linear profile is discretely exact, so the recorded L2/Linf errors at t=0.1 are pure spatial-discretization error from the sine mode, expected to fall as O(dx^2).

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
scope_excluded.typescript: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
